text_block_list.text:
During training. Right after telling <chrname>
to take a break...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Both of you worked so very hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sorry for surprising you out of nowhere~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, whenever I see someone trying their hardest,
I just can't help wanting to cheer them on.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If there's anything I can help with,
just let me know anytime~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now don't say that♪
Come on, come on, come on~♪

...With such hopeful eyes directed at me,
I couldn't bring myself to flatly refuse.
If she has a favor to ask, what could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The trick, you say? Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Would it be... to pamper them in moderation?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Giving it your all is important,
but if you're too strict, you won't last until the finish lineâª

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with pleasure♪ If you'd like,
why don't you try the same menu as me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll go get the dumbbells ready for you~.
I ended up doing weight training together with Super Creek.
